question_or_proposition: Footnote *10 assigns the (*10) numeric limits for Total Dissolved Solids, Net Increase (27,664 lbs/day daily maximum loading; 497 mg/L 30-day average concentration) to a given monitoring period when that period falls on or after the permit effective date and on or before the date that is three years after the permit effective date, rather than assigning the (*11) limits for that period.
required_context: Monitoring period dates within Federal FY2025
notes: Footnote *10 defines the temporal window for the first-phase TDS net increase limits marked (*10). Resolving how that window bounds applicability determines which enforceable numeric limits are used for FY2025 compliance comparisons when the permit effective date or the three-year boundary falls within or near that fiscal year.
